name: Alfredo Macaroni & Butternut Squash Bake with Spinach-Apple Salad

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil. Uncover, add butternut squash, pasta, and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until pasta reaches desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cup frozen butternut squash, pieces
425 g macaroni (elbow) pasta
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 Gala apples
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the apple and set aside.
When the pasta and butternut squash are done, drain and divide between two large baking dishes.
Add Alfredo sauce and spices to the baking dishes with the pasta and butternut squash. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (454 g) jars alfredo sauce
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place dishes in the oven and bake until sauce is warmed through and tops are golden, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Just before serving, add spinach, pumpkin seeds, and vinaigrette to the bowl with the apple and cucumber. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup pumpkin seeds
⅓ cup French vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta bake and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
